content:
mari: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — proposing we update the text-gen p95 SLO to 220ms and p99 to 420ms for the hosted tier. Current thresholds are too tight given the new long-context workload spike.

alex: +1 to re-evaluating. Can you paste the numbers and the rolling window you used?

mari: Using 30d rolling window, peak memory-backed KV cache evictions correlated with >350ms tails. Summary: 95th median 180ms, p95 260ms, p99 540ms during the incident window. Adjusted targets reflect expected queuing/backpressure.

sam: Who owns the rollout? We should A/B the new SLO config for one region first.\
mari: Proposal: eng-oncall to own configuration change, eng-platform to update dashboards and alerts, eng-sre to own the post-rollout verification. Timeline: patch in 3 business days, monitor 7 days, rollback plan if errorbudget burn > 10%.\
jordan: I can take dashboard updates. Will add a per-route p99 panel and an error budget burn gauge.\
tess: tagging @alex for alert tuning. For alerting, we should avoid noisy p95 alerts; prefer p99 alert with sustained breach over 5m.\
alex: Agreed. Proposed alert pseudo-rule:
\```
alert: TextGen_P99_Sustained
expr: increase(textgen_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.42"}[5m]) / increase(textgen_requests_total[5m]) < 0.98
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "/runbooks/textgen-p99"}
\```
\nlina: I can own the rollout plan and execute the config change with canary weight 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h if metrics look good.\
mari: Great. Lina: please include KV cache hit-rate and queue length metrics in the canary dashboard. If p99 increases > 20% from baseline, pause.\
lina: noted. I'll also add a synthetic prompt test that runs every 60s and emits latency and token-accuracy metrics.\
incident-bot: Incident #2024-195 closed by mari — followups assigned: lina (rollout), jordan (dashboards), alex (alerts), sam (verification). See /incidents/2024-195 for details.\
sam: For ownership: I'll verify for the 7-day window and run the regression eval suite daily. If quality regressions show up, we should revert SLO change and open a quick postmortem.\
jordan: Dashboard PR ready by EOD tomorrow. Will add links to the runbook and the incident note.\
alex: I'll lower alert sensitivity for p95 and implement the new p99 sustained rule. Also adding an internal note on expected errorbudget burn calculation: we cap automated escalation at 15% monthly variance.\
mari: One more ask: product SLA page needs to reflect the change for hosted tier. I'll draft a customer-facing blurb and loop in legal for phrasing.\
tess: FYI — recurring pattern note: similar spikes on long-context routes every ~6 weeks (see incident history). Can we schedule a follow-up hypothesis sprint to reduce KV eviction frequency?\
lina: I can collect matching traces and stack profiles. If we can reduce memory thrash by 10% we might restore old SLOs.\
mari: Ok action list (short):
- lina: rollout and synthetic checks (due +3 days)
- jordan: dashboard panels + runbook links (due +1 day)
- alex: implement p99 sustained alert and relax p95 alert (due +2 days)
- sam: verification & daily evals during 7d (start after rollout)
- mari: customer-facing SLA note draft (due +4 days)\
Please drop notes here as you make progress. :thumbsup:\
sam: I'll post daily checkpoints at 08:00 for the verification run.\
lina: Starting the canary tomorrow morning at 09:00 UTC. Will report initial metrics by 10:30.\
jordan: Dashboard PR opened: https://git.internal/r/dashboards/pulls/582 — pinged reviewers.\
alex: Alert PR: https://git.internal/r/alerts/pulls/307 — includes rule and test.\
mari: Thanks everyone. If we see the recurring 6-week pattern again during the 7-day window, we'll escalate to a focused infra sprint. Otherwise we'll close these follow-ups after rollout verification.\
incident-bot: Followup checklist updated: https://incidents.internal/2024-195/followups.\
lina: initial canary: p95=190ms, p99=410ms, KV hit-rate stable at 93% — no rollback conditions met so far.\
sam: saw the canary numbers, running eval now. Early pass on quality.\
mari: copying the runbook and adding final owners to the incident page. Closing thread when verification window completes.\
sam: 24h checkpoint: p99 drift +4%, errorbudget burn within expected range. continuing monitoring.\
lina: 72h checkpoint: p99 back within baseline, KV hit-rate unchanged. rolling to 100% tonight unless objections.\
alex: no objections. will watch alert noise.\
mari: rolling to 100% now. thanks all. :party_popper:
